questions.question: if block ka basic rule?
questions.answer: Condition True ho to indented block chalta hai. Colon aur correct indentation required hai.

questions.question: elif kaise decide hota hai?
questions.answer: Conditions upar se neeche check hoti hain. Pehli True branch execute hoti hai aur remaining branches skip hoti hain.
questions.explanation: TIP: 20-30 sec me clearly bolo. 20-30 sec me clearly bolo.

questions.question: Nested if kab use karein?
questions.answer: Jab pehle decision ke baad dependent second check karna ho.
questions.explanation: See model answer.

questions.question: Ternary operator kya hai?
questions.answer: Simple if-else ko one line me likhne ka syntax: value_if_true if condition else value_if_false.
questions.explanation: TIP: 20-30 sec me clearly bolo. 20-30 sec me clearly bolo.

questions.question: Truthy/Falsy kya hota hai?
questions.answer: Condition context me values ko boolean maana jata hai. 0, "", empty collections, None aur False falsy examples hain.
questions.explanation: TIP: 20-30 sec me clearly bolo.

questions.question: match-case kya hai?
questions.answer: Python 3.10+ ka pattern-matching structure jo ek value ke multiple cases handle kar sakta hai.
questions.explanation: TIP: 20-30 sec me clearly bolo. Mini speaking drill: Har answer bina PDF dekhe 2 baar bolo. Dusri baar ek real example add karo.
